mechanism: Sertraline may inhibit platelet aggregation increasing bleeding risk, while bumetanide causes electrolyte depletion and volume depletion that can potentiate hyponatremia and cardiovascular effects; both drugs can contribute to hyponatremia through different mechanisms.
action: Monitor electrolytes (particularly sodium), renal function, and blood pressure regularly; assess bleeding risk; ensure adequate hydration and consider baseline sodium levels before initiating combination therapy.
